fork.history: Original port stack consolidated, then rebased onto upstream. Consolidation does not imply all old changes were redundant. The original remote main and local backup preserve the old history.

upstreamReplacements: Native MDEC/VLC replaces the fork's libpress software decoder.
Upstream GTE core replaces fork transform implementations; only missing SDK color wrappers remain.
Hardware-accurate upstream SPU voice/reverb core replaces the old fork core; PCM mixing and diagnostic counters/traces remain.
Upstream kernel event/counter implementation replaces old libapi/libetc event and callback stubs.
Upstream voice allocator, sequence volume/key-off and libspu SDK implementations replace duplicated host functions; host sequence hooks remain.
SDL and nugget updated to the upstream-pinned commits.
retainedPortChanges: Native renderer present hooks, intermediate presentation, VRAM capture/snapshot APIs and classic texture context.
Compatibility raster accuracy/correction and sampling caches.
Deterministic frame timing, hidden headless windows and host input controls.
Virtual CD backend, bounded XA playback, CD audio reporting and host SEQ/PCM playback.
Rage Racer VAB placement and zero-voice allocator reset behavior.
gameAdaptations: GameApplyMatrixLV namespaces the game's differently typed helper away from the new upstream ApplyMatrixLV API.
Window-size diagnostic now queries SDL logical window dimensions explicitly; upstream display-size API reports pixels.
Mirror capture test uses logic-rate presentation so the requested diagnostic frame cannot be skipped by host pacing.
